doc:
# Deformations — Ad SCFT

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “relevant deformation holographic RG”).

claims.name: relevant_scalar_deformation_bath_state
claims.statement: A relevant scalar deformation of the bath state triggers a holographic RG flow whose trans-IR region changes from a Schwarzschild geometry to a Kasner universe.

claims.name: relevant_scalar_deformation_drives_holographic
claims.statement: A relevant scalar deformation drives the holographic electron cloud through an RG flow in a $(3+1)$-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell system coupled to a free fermion fluid.

claims.name: lifshitz_holography_dimensions_paper_identifies
claims.statement: For Lifshitz holography in $(n+1)$ dimensions, the paper identifies the $z=n-1$ deformation by marginally relevant operators generated by a momentum scale $\Lambda\sim 0$, giving slightly deformed Lifshitz spacetimes in the holographic description. At finite temperature these deformations drive an RG flow from UV Lifshitz to IR AdS.

claims.name: paper_connects_nonperturbative_vacuum_decay
claims.statement: The paper connects the non-perturbative vacuum decay of anti-de Sitter geometries to a corresponding relevant deformation and subsequent renormalization group (RG) flow in the boundary theory. Using the Ryu–Takayanagi conjecture, the authors compute the entanglement entropy of the holographic dual to analyze the nucleation and growth of vacuum bubbles.

sources.title: AdS Vacuum Bubbles, Holography and Dual RG Flows

claims.name: relevant_scalar_deformations_holographic_theories
claims.statement: For relevant scalar deformations of holographic theories on compact boundaries, exemplified by global AdS\(_4\) with a homogeneous non-normalizable scalar of \(m^2=-2\), the paper argues that finite boundary size truncates the flow into an incomplete RG, with corresponding incomplete C-theorem and attractor-like behavior, while geometric and entanglement quantities vary systematically with deformation strength.

sources.title: Incomplete RG: Hawking-Page transition, C-theorem and relevant scalar deformations of global AdS

claims.name: relevant_scalar_deformation_drives_holographic_
claims.statement: A relevant scalar deformation drives a holographic electron cloud in a $(3+1)$-dimensional Einstein-Maxwell system through an RG flow where the Einstein-Rosen bridge collapses into a positive-$p_t$ Kasner cosmology. The flow features a power-law decaying thermal $a$-function, two-point correlators probing the singularity, and novel Lifshitz and Kasner trans-IR fixed points absent in neutral flows.

claims.name: semiclassical_ads_black_hole_coupled
claims.statement: For a semiclassical AdS$_d$ black hole coupled to a thermal conformal bath, introducing a relevant scalar deformation triggers a holographic RG flow that deforms the trans-IR region to a Kasner universe. Tuning the independent scales of this flow produces nontrivial changes to the Page curve, demonstrating that a higher Page time arises from increased coarse-graining of the bath degrees of freedom.

claims.name: paper_argues_round_black_holes
claims.statement: The paper argues that round black holes, including their interiors, admit a consistent RG-flow interpretation by constructing a monotonic $a$ function, and shows that analytic continuation into the interior preserves imprints of UV physics near the classical singularity. In 2D holographic flows with relevant scalar deformations, this appears concretely as near-singularity Kasner exponents becoming deformation-dependent functions of the UV data and tracking UV phase transitions in entanglement entropy and scalar two-point functions.

sources.title: Imprints of phase transitions on Kasner singularities

claims.name: letter_made_first_steps_towards
claims.statement: In this letter we made first steps towards generalizing the BLG  and ABJM  superconformal Chern‑Simons gauge theories. We wrote down the superspace formulation for the $\mathrm{U}(N)\times \mathrm{U}(N)$ Chern‑Simons theories with bifundamental matter and a quartic superpotential of , which at level $k$ describe $N$ M2‑branes at a $\mathbbm{Z}_k$ orbifold . We also wrote down new theories describing $N$ M2‑branes at certain singularities $\mathbbm{C}^4/(\mathbbm{Z}_n\times \mathbbm{Z}_{kn})$. In Section we presented a family of non‑chiral quiver gauge theories which have $\mathcal{N}=4$ supersymmetry, and in Section a family of chiral quiver gauge theories possessing $\mathcal{N}=2$ supersymmetry. Finally, we conjectured that $k=1$ Chern‑Simons gauge theories with $\mathrm{SU}(3)$ invariant relevant superpotential deformation are dual to the holographic RG flows constructed in .

sources.title: Superconformal Chern-Simons Theories and AdS_4/CFT_3 Correspondence
